summary: Join our Climate Crisis and Humanitarian Response Course. Learn vital strategies to address climate issues and enhance your ability to aid affected populations.
lede: Climate crisis response training helps humanitarian and development professionals assess climate-related risks and organize assistance and recovery. Learners practice analyzing hazards, exposure and vulnerability, prioritizing at-risk groups, developing early-action triggers, and coordinating interventions across agencies. The syllabus also covers climate-sensitive programming, protection and accountability, digital mapping and monitoring, and response planning informed by risk evidence.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, coordinate, fund, monitor, or deliver climate crisis response across humanitarian and development settings. It supports emerging practitioners who need a structured foundation and experienced practitioners who need a common method for linking climate risk evidence with emergency action.
audience: Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning Officers
prerequisites: This foundation-to-intermediate course requires practical exposure to humanitarian, disaster risk reduction, climate adaptation, development, public health, logistics, or community programming. You do not need prior expertise in the Sendai Framework, Sphere Handbook, GIS, or climate modelling, and coding is not required. Basic spreadsheet use, familiarity with your organization’s response cycle, and access to one example risk or programme document will help you apply the exercises.
